purpose: Make the five-backbone experiment decide a mechanism or rule out a next direction, rather than count five model substitutions as innovations.

primary_joint_control.contrast: Joint63 minus Separated63, before and after own ordinary
primary_joint_control.matched: Exact same parameter tensors, initialization, electrodes, training permissions, targets and exposure budget
primary_joint_control.changed: Allowed attention connections and their computational path
primary_joint_control.does_not_isolate: It does not by itself isolate compression timing, make FLOPs equal, or prove separated attention lacks global access.

electrode_control.interpretation: Electrode support plus 5888 positional parameters and compute differences; do not attribute this contrast solely to a new attention rule.

protocol_check: Compare the fresh MLP base and own ordinary to original parent and matched ordinary using the complete saved per-query tables. If the new training protocol weakens MLP, investigate this before making a claim about all backbone families. No partial-image inspection or refitting.

candidate_routes.pattern: Joint63 improves over the parameter-matched separated model in stimulus discrimination and final images, with the Joint17/MLP17 comparison supporting a gain under posterior electrodes.
candidate_routes.next: Investigate the EEG-specific interaction/compression mechanism; use an additional matched intervention before calling compression timing causal or proposing an original method.

candidate_routes.pattern: 63-electrode models improve over 17-electrode models but joint attention has no confirmed advantage over the matched separated control.
candidate_routes.next: Study useful measurement support and electrode interactions; do not claim joint attention itself as the innovation.

candidate_routes.pattern: Condition-space stimulus discrimination improves on complete Dcheck, while final image semantics do not improve or only SSIM rises.
candidate_routes.next: Localize how encoded stimulus evidence is used by A/P/IP and final images. Do not conclude the encoder is useless or immediately repeat another response-MSE loss.

candidate_routes.pattern: Own ordinary helps some backbones and hurts others.
candidate_routes.next: Analyze the predefined backbone-by-ordinary interaction and native coordinates/distributions. Portability is a training principle to validate, not one universal checkpoint.

candidate_routes.pattern: Only an existing ATM backbone improves, without support from the mechanism controls.
candidate_routes.next: Retain it as the stronger baseline; this is not our second original algorithm or an official ATM pipeline reproduction.

candidate_routes.pattern: No full-study semantic advantage is supported across the candidate controls.
candidate_routes.next: Use train/OOF/Dfit/Dcheck and image differences to distinguish optimization, generalization and interface explanations. Do not automatically enlarge models or append similar losses.

comparison_policy: All planned final models, all830 images each, all14 readouts and all registered controls remain. Interpret semantic, within-concept and low-level changes together. CI crossing zero is not equivalence or noninferiority; one isolated metric does not terminate the remaining experiment.
limits: One recovered R4 subject, fixed25epochs not a convergence proof, exposed development, no independentH/multiseed/completeSEED or complete second generative host. No outcome guarantees novelty, SOTA or CCFA acceptance.
